response.summary: Acme Retail saved ₹92,487 per month and ₹11,09,843 per year, cutting 421.2 kg CO₂e annually. Three actions ran automatically, five required approval, and two were blocked. Blocked actions: prod-web-01 RESIZE was stopped because the production environment is protected, and sandbox-ml TERMINATE was disallowed by policy and tag instructions. One action, staging-api RESIZE, was rolled back after its health check took 850 ms, exceeding the 300 ms threshold. All other actions completed successfully. No pending approvals remain.
